title: H0215 (2023 Regular): Possession or Use of a Firearm in a Sensitive Location

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2023-01-17; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2023/215/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2644186))

operative_text: Section 1 (new s. 790.075, F.S.): (1) As used in this section, the term "sensitive location" means any of the following: (a) Any part of a healthcare facility licensed by the state, including a hospital, nursing home or other similar residential facility, or provider of services for the care, support, or treatment of individuals. (b) Any part of a building owned, leased, or operated by a governmental entity, including a polling place, courthouse, or law enforcement facility. (c) Any park, recreational facility or area, or playground owned or controlled by a state, county, municipality, or other governmental entity. (d) Any place of worship or religious observation. (2) Any other law notwithstanding, a person may not possess a firearm in a sensitive location. (a) Except as provided in paragraph (b), a person who violates this subsection commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084. (b) A person who discharges a firearm while violating this subsection commits a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.
